title: MAJOR IN SOCIOLOGY (Brescia) Faculty of Social Science - Sociology

sections.heading: MAJOR IN SOCIOLOGY (Brescia)
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 from Sociology courses at the 1000 level with a mark of at least 60% in each course.
1.0 course from: Sociology 2240E or Sociology 2270A/B and Sociology 2271A/B.
2.0 courses in Sociology numbered 2200 and above.
2.0 courses in Sociology numbered 2100 and above.

Note: Students enrolled in a Major Module in Sociology as part of an Honours Double Major are required to complete 1.0 courses in Sociology numbered 3000-3999 for one of their 1.0 courses in Sociology numbered 2100 and above.
For those students interested in applying for graduate programs, it is strongly recommended that you take Sociology 3306A/B and Sociology 3307F/G.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
